safety.title: Scam warnings aimed at older adults
safety.subtitle: Read together with your grandparents and remember: hang up, ask family, then decide.

deepfake.title: Fake video call (Deepfake)
deepfake.desc: Scammers use AI to copy a grandchild's face and voice and ask for urgent money.
deepfake.do1: Hang up and call back your grandchild's usual number
deepfake.do2: Agree on a secret question only family knows
deepfake.dont1: Don't send money just because you see a face and hear a familiar voice
deepfake.dont2: Don't act when you are rushed or told to keep it secret

bank.title: Fake bank text message
bank.desc: A text says your account is locked and includes a strange link to steal passwords and OTP codes.
bank.do1: Open the official bank app yourself or call the number printed on your card
bank.do2: Ask a relative to check any strange message
bank.dont1: Don't tap links in text messages
bank.dont2: Never read out an OTP code or password to anyone

police.title: Fake police or government officials
police.desc: A caller claims to be police, says you are linked to a case and demands money to "verify" you.
police.do1: Hang up and tell family or your local police station
police.do2: Remember: authorities do not handle cases over the phone
police.dont1: Don't give your ID number or account number
police.dont2: Don't move money to a "safe" account
